plan: A split-level modern hotel suite structured around a multi-tier platform layout that divides the space into functional zones. The elevated rear zone features an open-concept bathroom enclosed by structural glass partitions. The central main tier holds a low-profile platform bed frame integrated into a floor-to-ceiling wooden accent bulkhead, flanked by a built-in cantilevered desk. The lower-level sunken lounge at the front is bordered by modular L-shaped seating and a low media console, ending at a massive structural window frame that opens to a narrow cantilevered concrete balcony with physical glass railings.

prompt: A modern hotel room

children.prompt: An elevated open-concept bathroom zone situated at the rear of the suite, enclosed by structural glass partitions and elevated above the main floor to define a luxury sanctuary.

The central main tier of the suite hosting a low-profile platform bed frame integrated into a floor-to-ceiling wooden accent bulkhead, flanked by a built-in cantilevered desk, linking the bathroom and the lounge.
A cozy, lower-level sunken lounge zone at the front of the suite, bordered by comfortable modular L-shaped seating and a low media console, leading up to the balcony window.
A narrow cantilevered concrete balcony extending outside the suite's large front window frame, featuring physical glass railings to offer unhindered outdoor views.
